text: Bitcoin's 1.7% decline is outpacing Ethereum's 0.8% drop, suggesting traders are rotating away from the larger asset and into alts despite both majors declining. The Fear & Greed index sits at 27 (extreme fear) with a slight upward tick over the past week, indicating sentiment has stabilized somewhat though conviction remains weak. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 56.5% with moderate volume ($62B) signals neither panic selling nor strong accumulation—the market is largely waiting.
